scripts.open_chat:
\set c random(1, 1000000)
SELECT id, role, left(content, 40), created_at FROM messages WHERE chat_id = :c ORDER BY created_at;
scripts.sidebar:
\set u random(1, 100000)
SELECT id, title FROM chats WHERE user_id = :u ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20;
scripts.login:
\set u random(1, 100000)
SELECT id, plan FROM users WHERE email = 'user' || :u || '@example.com';
scripts.search:
\set c random(100000, 999999)
SELECT id, title FROM chats WHERE title LIKE 'Chat ' || :c || '%' ORDER BY id LIMIT 10;
scripts.usage:
\set o random(2, 20001)
SELECT sum(tokens) FROM usage_events WHERE org_id = :o;
scripts.report:
\set d random(0, 100)
SELECT model, count(*), sum(tokens) FROM messages WHERE created_at >= timestamptz '2025-09-01' + :d * interval '1 day' AND created_at < timestamptz '2025-09-01' + (:d + 3) * interval '1 day' GROUP BY model;
